test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
concept: Person in News, Appointments and Resignations
question: Who has been appointed as the Director of the Forest Research Institute in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Renu Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Renu Singh** was appointed as the **Director of the Forest Research Institute (FRI)** in Dehradun on March 1, 2022.
 
• She is the **first woman to hold this position in the institute's 117-year history**.
 
• Prior to this appointment, Renu Singh was serving as the **Joint Director of FRI **and had been associated with the institute for over 30 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **The Forest Research Institute**

 
• The Forest Research Institute is one of the oldest and most prestigious institutions in the field of forestry research in India.
 
• It was established in **1906 **and is currently under the **Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education (ICFRE)**.
